identity.title: Reject execution errors as ExpectedFailure quality NG

origin.summary: 2D-026 requires ExpectedFailure samples to distinguish controlled quality NG from crashes, timeouts, invalid tools, and partial execution errors.

state.current_summary: 2D-026 remains resolved; final post-documentation Debug and Release builds/contracts also pass 8/8 with the same typed ExpectedFailure behavior.

objective.summary: ExpectedFailure validation passes only controlled quality NG or an explicitly declared controlled no-result/error outcome, while arbitrary execution errors fail closed.
constraints: Reuse VisionPipelineResultSummaryService, VisionPipelineBatchOutcomeContract, VisionPipelineSampleCheckService, and RunVisionSampleCatalog.ps1.
Keep existing CSV rows compatible; unspecified optional fields must be reported as legacy rather than claimed as strong contracts.
Preserve existing metric, artifact, metadata, Explore, Required, and CSV parsing behavior except for the required classification guard.
Keep test data and evidence on D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev; do not change Original, release, deploy, or external systems.

criteria.text: A typed ExpectedFailure contract accepts controlled quality NG or explicitly allowed controlled no-result/error and rejects crash, timeout, invalid-tool, unknown-error, and partial-artifact execution failures.
Existing metric, artifact, and metadata assertions remain active; non-finite metrics fail; Explore/Required policy is unchanged; rows without optional fields are visibly marked legacy.
Focused Debug and Release builds/contracts and a bounded catalog or runner fixture pass, with evidence recorded in the issue and handoff.

evidence.observation: Debug and Release ExpectedFailure contracts each passed 8/8, including strict quality NG, strict controlled no-result, legacy labeling, timeout rejection, invalid-tool rejection, error/step mismatch rejection, and two actual sample-service runs.

The three-row strict catalog fixture completed with GateStatus=OK, OKRows=3, and artifact/metric checks intact. The invalid/missing-pipeline fixture returned nonzero with GateStatus=NG and preserved contract, metadata, metric, and missing-artifact failures.
The owner map, optional CSV contract, legacy boundary, typed error allow-list, finite metric rule, verification commands, and unverified runtime boundaries are recorded for developer navigation.
After the final service-message preservation adjustment, Debug and Release builds completed with 0 errors and the ExpectedFailure contract again passed 8/8 in both configurations.

events.summary: Reuse existing typed runner summaries and keep controlled no-result compatibility; do not add a second runner or qualification state owner.
All 2D-026 completion criteria are satisfied by current typed-contract, catalog-fixture, and build evidence.
